# AI coding model prices

Every rate Tokimeter uses to value token usage, in USD per 1M tokens, with
the source and verification date for each provider.

These are **API list prices**, not what a subscription costs. Tokimeter applies
them to locally recorded token counts to produce an API-equivalent value, which
it marks `~$` precisely because it is not a bill. See
[the pricing methodology](PRICING.md) for how that distinction is enforced.

66 models across 9 providers.
5 providers have a recorded source; 4 do not and are marked below.

## Scheduled rate changes

Dated changes a provider has already announced. CI fails once one of these
comes due and the table still carries the old rate, so a promotional price
cannot quietly go stale.

| Model | Effective | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `claude-sonnet-5` | 2026-08-31 | Introductory $2 input / $10 output applies through 2026-08-31, then reverts to the $3 / $15 sticker price. |

## How to read this

- A model missing from this table is **unpriced**. Tokimeter excludes unpriced
  models from priced totals rather than guessing a rate.
- Cache write shows `1.25× input` where a provider publishes no explicit rate;
  that is the documented fallback, not a published price.
- A provider marked `not recorded` still has working rates, but the source and
  verification date were never captured. Treat those as lower confidence.
- Local overrides in `~/.tokimeter/pricing.json` and the opt-in community feed
  take precedence in that order and are not shown here.
